measurement.order: Git CLI and libgit2 runs alternated which ran first on each iteration.

libgit2.method: Open Repository, push HEAD plus refs/heads/* and refs/remotes/* into a TIME-sorted revwalk, read each commit message, apply ASCII case-insensitive fixed substring matching, stop after 51 matches.

interpretation: On this fixture and query, the libgit2 full-message scan was slower than the Git CLI path. Only one commit matched, so equality does not establish result ordering for multi-match or multi-branch histories. The candidate is not suitable for replacing the service search path based on this measurement.
